caption: The drawing depicts a standing human figure on a rectangular pedestal, facing forward. The figure is dressed in a knee-length yellow skirt with a red band at the hem, a green short-sleeved top with white trim, and a sash draped across the torso in a muted pink color. The figure’s arms are both bent: the right arm is raised and holds a bundle of brown cylindrical objects, while the left arm is at the side, holding a rectangular block colored greyish-purple. Decorative elements include a necklace of round beads and a prominent headdress with several large, cream-colored feathers radiating upward and outward, secured by a brown band. The figure is wearing shoes that are green with red accents. The skin is colored in naturalistic tones, with long dark hair falling past the shoulders. The background is plain and off-white, showing no other objects or scenery.
title: Cigar Store Pocahontas
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
